title: Documentation placeholder under a high-signal credential name
summary: An environment assignment to EXAMPLECLOUD_API_KEY holds the provider's documented placeholder text.
rationale: The variable name signals a credential, but the value is documented as an example and was never issued.

expectation.rationale: The provider documentation labels this exact value as a placeholder.

sources.supports: Shows exc_live_YOUR_API_KEY_HERE as an example, not an issued key.
